Strategy: Reward bins whose residual capacity itself lies between seventy and ninety, regardless of the item, preferring loose bins in absolute terms. It may help by spending the loosest bins first, but may fail by ignoring how much room the item actually leaves behind.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r >= 70 and r <= 90 else 0) for r in bins]
```
